explanation: Sort closed intervals by right endpoint. Whenever the next interval is not already covered by the last chosen point, choose its right endpoint. This leaves the latest possible point that still covers the earliest-ending uncovered interval.
spaceComplexity: O(n) space for the copied intervals, plus sorting stack.
